title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 275 Penn Avenue in Salem, Ohio, as the "Howard Arthur Tibbs Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 275 Penn Avenue in Salem, Ohio, as the Howard Arthur Tibbs Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named a post office in Salem, Ohio after Howard Arthur Tibbs.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 275 Penn Avenue in Salem, Ohio, as the Howard Arthur Tibbs Post Office. It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or its services. The official summary describes only the designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022.
